transformations.rationale: Replaced the seed recorder with an executable target harness preserving the Rust 1.96 as_chunks_mut control flow and using reviewed unsafe dependency contracts for split_at_mut_unchecked and as_chunks_unchecked_mut. The previous target-local split_at_mut_unchecked external_body wrapper is replaced by an executable source-shaped helper; the mutable raw start-pointer helper now uses the executable null-provenance length-address model while raw-parts and final-frame boundaries remain named externals.
